style.styleTitle: Everlands 270cm Grandis Pre-Lit Christmas Red Bow Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Add instant warmth and festive charm to your stair railing, mantelpiece, or door with the 270cm Everlands Grandis Garland, beautifully adorned with red velvet bows. </p><p>Featuring a lush mix of real PE needles and soft PVC needles, this incredibly dense garland boasts a rich, natural look. Subtly lit by 80 warm white micro LEDs, you can choose from 8 different twinkle effects ranging from a calm steady glow to a sparkling, festive display.</p><p><strong>Key Features:</strong></p><ul><li>Dimensions: 270cm (Length) x 20cm (Diameter)<br></li><li>Foliage: 370 natural-looking tips (220 PE and 150 PVC) for a lush appearance<br></li><li>Lighting: 80 warm white micro LEDs with 8-function twinkle effect and steady mode<br></li><li>Power: Battery-operated (Requires 3x AA batteries) for approx. 32 hours of burn time<br></li><li>Extras: Decorated with 5 Red Velvet bows, features a 6-hour timer, and a green cable with a 30cm lead wire<br></li><li>Use: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use</li></ul>
